title: Shah bought laser isotope enrichment technology from Switzerland

tellings.quote: that as amazing, the Shaw bought laser isotope enrichment technology from Switzerland in 1970.

plain: A writer named Jason Jorjani says on Jesse Michels' podcast that in 1970 the Shah, the king who then ruled Iran, bought laser isotope enrichment technology from Switzerland. This is a method of using lasers to separate forms of uranium, a key step toward nuclear fuel or weapons. Jorjani calls it amazing because it would mean Iran had very advanced nuclear technology far earlier than people think.
